Deny-list denials keep `<command> is denied by the Copilot deny list (<stem>)`, `rm:*` included; `sh <script>` stays denied. The rules are read from the embedded `fence/plan.json`; reading `fence/review.json` for this phase, or a second hand-copied list or path list, is a violation.
